notes.title: Early Access Build 1.12
notes.content:
These patch notes come along with an update, though they also include some undocumented changes I put out in very small updates over the past week or so (in chronological order).

[list]
[*] Split the centered speed display setting into an upper and lower option that determines whether the display is shown above or below the crosshair.
[*] Fixed an issue where fully resetting a map on the same tick that you respawn at a checkpoint grants you the checkpoint after fully resetting.
[*] Fixed new keybinds reappearing if you add and delete them in the same play session.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The speed display setting is now a dropdown with an additional "Centered" option. This option will show the speed display just above the crosshair.
[*] Slightly changed how text looks and how it's scaled with resolution.
[*] Fixed an issue where the time of a replay in the replay viewer would be different than the time saved to the file.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.06
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Using reset binds in the pause menu is now restricted to the initial menu and only works on full maps.
[*] Fixed hit indicators appearing during replay loading.
[*] Fixed the tooltip for the input display setting.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.05
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Feature: Hit Indicators
[*] By default, you'll now be shown the horizontal direction you've been hit by a rocket from. This HUD element can be disabled in the options menu.
[*] Reverted the changes made to reset binds in 1.02, since they may be causing desyncs.
[*] Using a reset bind while the game is paused will now fully restart the map and begin recording a new replay.
[*] Fixed incomplete replays sometimes being deleted when they shouldn't be.
[*] Fixed error handling for invalid/corrupted replays.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Dynamic FOV and Strafe Lean toggles not loading from the settings file on startup.
[*] Replays may load a little bit faster now.
[/list]
I'm also aware of a bug with borderless fullscreen that causes the window to be misaligned on startup. If you run into this bug, please let me know what sort of monitor setup you have (number of monitors, resolutions, etc.), since I've been unable to replicate it on multiple computers.

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the final map being visible when it hasn't been unlocked yet in certain cases.
[*] Fixed a typo in the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Disabled the ability to bind mouse wheel to actions. This didn't work properly and was just causing confusion.
[*] Using a reset bind before reaching a checkpoint will now reset the timer and start recording a new replay.
[*] Using a reset bind no longer starts the timer at the start of a map.
[*] Made a few medal times a bit more lenient. Congratulations to anyone who achieved them before this!
[/list]
